protocol.checkpoint_selection: Digits: highest MNIST validation accuracy. Shapes: full-frame validation target macro-F1 with synthetic validation accuracy guard; region parameters chosen on validation only. Test never used for training or selection.
protocol.shape_data_scope: Synthetic classification test is reserved; scene suite reuses fixed phase-3 scenes as regression. Real data roles are separate.

geometry_training_v4.policy: Development candidates only for real training; validation candidates never augmented or trained. New real test never proposed or inferred. Synthetic reserved input hashes exclude exact duplicates; labels not consulted.
geometry_training_v4.limits: Bbox-overlap candidate labels are weak supervision, manually defined outer-object policy; not pixel-mask ground truth. Near duplicates remain possible.

protocol.stress_scope: touching/overlapping objects deliberately excluded from supported-scene metrics

digits.baseline_note: provided EMNIST/Infinity ANN; no retraining; comparison is checkpoint behavior, not a controlled architecture ablation

normalized_input_deduplication.scope: All actual normalized proposal inputs, including every polarity/color/hull branch. Reused fixed scenes are regression, not a newly unseen scene benchmark. No scene removed by score or post-hoc identity.

deduplication.identity: SHA-256 of round(clip(normalized_32x32,0,1)*255), uint8 row-major; labels excluded
deduplication.near_duplicate_scope: Exact float32 and uint8-equivalent images only; not a guarantee against all perceptually similar shapes.

annotation_policy.unit: Projected 2D outer silhouette, not physical object category. Approximately circular discs/coins are circle; quadrilateral cassette/floppy shells with mild chamfers are rectangle (including squares).
annotation_policy.exclude: Text, holes, spokes/slots, printed images and shadows inside an outer object are not separate targets. Elliptical projections are explicit distractors, not circle targets.
annotation_policy.coordinates: Integer xywh half-open in distributed image pixels; max side 800. Newly added photos max side 600.
annotation_policy.annotation_quality: Manual single-annotator boxes checked on coordinate grids before phase-4 inference. No pixel masks or second annotator. Occluded bboxes remain estimates in stress cases; clipped boxes use visible extent.
annotation_policy.scope: Basic complete approximately front-facing silhouettes evaluated separately from clipping/occlusion and negative frames. Overlapping circles remain unsupported stress targets; no promise of amodal reconstruction.

audit.statistical_scope: Convenience sample of photographs and a few clearly marked scans, not a representative population benchmark.

limits: One digit at a time; no alphabetic or multi-digit OCR.
Synthetic classification, reused scene regression and real-photo roles are reported separately. This pilot is not representative of all photos.
Touching/overlapping objects can merge into one connected component.
Very thin/open contours, complex backgrounds, low contrast, clipped shapes and unknown objects can fail.
Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities of correctness.
